rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Let Them Keep Hope
card.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

card.title: Let Them Keep Hope
card.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

card.title: Admit You’re Hurt
card.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

card.title: Admit You’re Hurt
card.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? Are you making a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Mine says 'unprofessional'; I'm changing that to 'I went home and cried.'

card.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
card.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

card.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
card.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want to glue it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

card.title: I Can Handle This
card.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.

card.title: I Can Handle This
card.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completely prepared for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My approach exactly. Leave the jug; I prefer a thorough preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I always arrange a reader. Start gently; that's part of my system.

card.title: Outfeel the Room
card.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm scared I'll freeze.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.

card.title: Outfeel the Room
card.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.

card.title: Hope Keeps Moving
card.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall rejected our wedding booking. Apparently we're meant to marry somewhere less municipal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then September gives us three more months to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Their garden! We're finally finding out where this wedding belongs.

card.title: Hope Keeps Moving
card.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop didn't work here. Hope needs a better postcode.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have no moving money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs a smaller first address.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A market stall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The dream's learning to travel light.

card.title: Comfort Everyone Else
card.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have another tissue. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.

card.title: Comfort Everyone Else
card.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

card.title: Emotional Interest
card.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I admitted I'm scared to meet your mother. Before Sunday, I need an equally embarrassing truth from you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to confess.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I went first because I trusted you'd meet me halfway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm scared she'll like you more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That counts. I'll stop calling you confident when I introduce us.

card.title: Emotional Interest
card.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay through this hard conversation. Someday I need you equally open with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you keeping score?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not points. A place where both of us can be unsteady.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say that honestly. It's a first payment.

card.title: Ready on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk about the argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. Tonight I can finish one sentence without leaving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where do we start?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With the argument, and permission to pause.

card.title: Ready on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit by the door while we talk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you planning to run?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Knowing I can leave is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can risk a less careful answer.

card.title: The Same Ending
card.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring you soup tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

card.title: The Same Ending
card.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're at the early chapter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the reassuring line that usually comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss the argument over toast, but I'm keeping the chair beside the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you planning to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm planning to stay without feeling trapped. Butter?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put the toast within reach. I can risk the first honest sentence now.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses S118-single-b's food offered without requiring a calmer feeling and D119-single-b's door-side seat and permission to stop. A1 combines toast with an exit condition; A3 answers B2's fear of departure by making safety a condition of staying, and A5 uses B4's permission to risk an honest sentence. Practical acceptance changes how A seeks safe openness. This corrects exact attribution only; pair review remains pending.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're furious, and I'm frightened. Water first; then one question I can answer without rushing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have a year's worth of questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Tonight needs a manageable glass, not the whole reservoir.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which question?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The one about yesterday. Let me finish that before refilling anything.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses S118-single-a's water and practical space for an unresolved feeling, with D119-single-a's limited conversation rather than the whole year's dispute. A1 makes water precede one manageable answer; A3 reduces the scale after B2 names the year, and A5 answers B4 by choosing yesterday's question. The reservoir comparison is this pair's adaptation. Exact pair review remains pending.

card.title: What Do You Need Now?
card.instruction: Accept every feeling as real, then translate it into water, space, a plan, a boundary, or the next practical step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can be furious about the cancelled train and still have toast before we drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't think about food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wrap it. You can decide when we're on the road.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't spend the drive telling me to calm down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Directions only. The toast won't require a better attitude either.

card.title: What Do You Need Now?
card.instruction: Accept every feeling as real, then translate it into water, space, a plan, a boundary, or the next practical step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Opening night without the lead you wanted hurts. Water, or some space in my dressing room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Water won't make me happy for her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. It just means you can be furious without a dry throat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming to ask if I'm okay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask her to wait until after the show. You only owe her your cues tonight.
